topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Rain's been coming down hard all day, just like the stories people tell when they're up against the wall. Now, here I am, listening to a kid who's been tagged with plagiarism. He swears he’s clean, says the paper was all his, no shortcuts. Kids these days, they think they can outsmart the system, but I've heard it all before. His eyes dart around the room, but they don't quite hit mine. I let the silence stretch, the way it does when the world’s closing in. He fidgets with a wrinkled page, probably the one that got him into this mess. I lean back, studying the cracks in the ceiling, waiting for the story to seep through the lies. Bet it's not the first time he's taken the fall. Bet it's not the last.
